description.en: Help-center home for a set of help articles. Each top-level area of the product's navigation structure becomes a category card with its article count and article list.
description.ko: 도움말 묶음의 헬프센터 홈. 제품 라우트 계층의 최상위 영역이 카테고리 카드가 되고, 그 아래에 아티클 수와 목록을 표시

purpose.en: Route a customer's question to the right help article.
purpose.ko: 고객의 질문을 알맞은 도움말 문서로 안내합니다.

job.en: Answer "which page has my answer?" for a help-article set.
job.ko: 도움말 묶음에서 "내 문제는 어느 문서에 있어요?"에 답합니다.

required_input.en: Reviewed product features selected for the help set; the product's navigation structure provides the categories and is optional
required_input.ko: 도움말 묶음으로 선택한 검토 완료 기능. 제품 탐색 구조가 있으면 카테고리로, 없으면 평탄 목록

link_extension.description: File extension appended to help article links.

link_prefix.description: Path prefix for help article links, for example ./pages/ when the articles are published in a subfolder.

support_url.description: Customer support URL for the footer contact link.

en.title: Help Center
en.intro: Browse by area of the product to find the guide for what you're trying to do.
en.empty: No help articles are available yet.
